decisions.reason: An inbound SMS API is a core feature of a messaging platform, costs little to maintain, and has had its own page consistently since launch.
The email-to-SMS gateway reuses the existing SMS infrastructure at low marginal cost and serves enterprise customers with legacy systems, so dropping it would gain little.
The SMS-to-email gateway complements Products A and B as part of a coherent two-way messaging offering and adds little operational burden.
